app.title: I'm making LLMs work on small and old devices
app.description: A lightweight LLM inference stack designed to run on low‑resource or older hardware, featuring quantization, pruning and hardware acceleration hooks.
proposed_tests: import smolmaxxing; model = smolmaxxing.load('tinyllama-2'); output = model('Hello world')
measure inference latency on a 512‑byte prompt on a Raspberry Pi 4
compare accuracy to the same model run in Ollama
